item.title: Three suspected narco-terrorists killed in US military strike on drug-trafficking vessel in Eastern Pacific
item.summary: SOUTHCOM said Tuesday that the U.S. military carried out a lethal strike on a vessel in the Eastern Pacific, killing three suspected narco-terrorists on a drug-trafficking route.

item.title: Zelenskyy blasts ‘absolute cynicism’ as deadly Russian barrage hits Ukraine before planned ceasefire
item.summary: Russian drone and missile strikes killed at least 22 people and wounded more than 80 across Ukraine, as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy blasted Moscow’s “absolute cynicism."

item.title: IDF claims to have taken out Hamas commander who participated in Oct 7
item.summary: The IDF announced it killed Hamas Nukhba Commander Anas Hamed in a targeted Gaza airstrike, saying he raided Israel during the Oct. 7 Nova massacre.

item.title: 200,000 small boat arrivals loom amid UK raising threat level to ‘severe’ following recent terror attack
item.summary: The U.K. is approaching 200,000 small boat arrivals across the English Channel since 2018, according to official figures cited by British media reports.

item.title: US-backed pipeline proposal targets global reliance on Strait of Hormuz amid Iran threats
item.summary: The Strait of Hormuz crisis is pushing Gulf states and the U.S. to develop alternative energy routes, reducing dependence on one vulnerable choke point.

item.title: German officials warn Islamist, far-left rhetoric driving spike in antisemitic attacks
item.summary: Germany faces a "new normal" of antisemitism driven by Islamist and left-wing extremist networks, according to a nationwide report by the Central Council of Jews in Germany.

item.title: China fireworks factory explosion: Video captures devastating aftermath of blast that left at least 26 dead
item.summary: An explosion at a fireworks factory in in China's Hunan province killed at least 26 people and injured 61 others, according to state media reports.

item.title: US kills 2 more suspected drug traffickers in boat strike
item.summary: Joint Task Force Southern Spear conducted a lethal strike on a vessel in the Caribbean tied to suspected drug trafficking, killing two people.

item.title: South African police airlift massive crocodile suspected of eating missing local
item.summary: A massive crocodile suspected of eating a missing businessman was airlifted by helicopter from South Africa's Komati River after being euthanized.

item.title: Alberta separatists say they have enough signatures for referendum on leaving Canada
item.summary: Stay Free Alberta declared it has enough signatures to trigger a vote on Alberta leaving Canada, with a provincewide ballot possible by October 2025.
